sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Candidate is semantically faithful and deterministic validation is valid: applicability is restricted to longitudinal side members, member-owned strength and collapse-load operands are compared against each represented load-case demand in the correct direction, ship/member/load-case ownership and canonical units are correct, and frameProfileType is retained as the required ship-owned relationship.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS

Deterministic validation prevents acceptance. Fix: Unknown canonical benchmark IRI(s): https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#ApplicableLongitudinalSideFrameShape, https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#KiloNewtonQuantityShape, https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#LoadCaseDemandShape, https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#StructuralMemberApplicabilityShape, https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#UnspecifiedQuantityShape
Semantic validator feedback: Replace the invented canonical-namespace shape IRIs (ApplicableLongitudinalSideFrameShape, StructuralMemberApplicabilityShape, LoadCaseDemandShape, KiloNewtonQuantityShape, and UnspecifiedQuantityShape) with blank-node or non-vocabulary SHACL shapes. Remove the unrelated mandatory frameProfileType check. Correct applicability so only structural members with longitudinalFrameOrientation=true and structuralLocation=sideStructureLocation are constrained; the current sh:or branches incorrectly allow false orientation and non-side locations to pass. Preserve the required member-owned load-case, demand, plasticStrength, and midspanPlasticCollapseLoad checks and the demand comparison.

Deterministic validation prevents acceptance. Fix: COMPLETE dependency relationship(s) absent from candidate: frameProfileType
Semantic validator feedback: REVERSAL: The COMPLETE dependency contract and deterministic error require frameProfileType on its authoritative ship owner; therefore the earlier instruction to remove that check is no longer valid. Add a ship-targeted relationship constraint for nltl:frameProfileType without inventing a controlled value or datatype. Also remove the applicability shape's sh:minCount constraints, which incorrectly require represented members and applicability fields to exist; applicability must be selected by existing longitudinalFrameOrientation=true and structuralLocation=sideStructureLocation values. Do not require a load case merely because an applicable member exists: preserve the universal rule over represented load cases and avoid accidental existence/pass logic. Retain member-owned plasticStrength and midspanPlasticCollapseLoad, load-case-owned combinedShearAndBendingDemand, their kN decimal validation, and the demand-not-exceeding comparison.

Repair the comparison and units. The candidate requires midspanPlasticCollapseLoad only by presence but never uses it as the plastic-strength threshold; include the declared midspan collapse-load operand in the faithful demand-versus-strength comparison (or explicitly model the permitted relationship to plasticStrength), without exact equality for a derived decimal. Replace every qudt:KiloN unit IRI, which expands to the schema namespace, with the canonical unit IRI http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/KiloN. Preserve the ship-owned frameProfileType relationship, member-owned applicability and strength quantities, load-case-owned demand, and the universal no-load-case-existence behavior.

Candidate is semantically faithful and deterministic validation is valid: applicability is restricted to longitudinal side members, member-owned strength and collapse-load operands are compared against each represented load-case demand in the correct direction, ship/member/load-case ownership and canonical units are correct, and frameProfileType is retained as the required ship-owned relationship.
